notes:
## Protecting your recomps
- Recomps now install into a hidden, permission-locked folder instead of a browsable one — other accounts on the PC can't wander in
- The downloaded copy is deleted after install, and debug symbols, source and build leftovers are stripped out, so there's nothing lying around to copy or poke at
- Already-installed recomps get locked automatically too, the next time Hanami starts
- The game's own files and your saves are untouched — this only hides the parts a code-thief would go for
